description: Screen the whole market on ONE completed interval with several conditions ANDed together. Pick bar (1d, the default, or 1h on a Pro key; a free key is screened at 1d). Conditions use op >, <, >=, <=, between, top_pct or bottom_pct; top_pct/bottom_pct are deciles of your eligible markets, and the liquidity floor (USD/day at either bar) is applied before the deciles so they are measured over the population you are choosing from. Answers 'top-decile funding with bottom-decile open-interest change' and 'open interest rising faster than volume'. A market that does not report a field never satisfies a condition on it.

column.description:
The field to test, from `list_fields`. Accepted under either name —
`field`, which is what every other argument on this surface calls it, or
its original `column`. Validated as present rather than required by the
schema, so a condition that names no field is rejected by name below
instead of by a deserializer message no caller can act on.

op.description:
One of `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `between`, `top_pct`, `bottom_pct`.
`top_pct`/`bottom_pct` keep the best/worst `value` percent of the
markets you can see by that field.

value.description:
The threshold. For `top_pct`/`bottom_pct` this is a percentage, e.g. 10
for the top decile.

value2.description: Required for `between`: the upper bound, inclusive.

bar.description:
`1d` (the default) for completed UTC days, `1h` for completed UTC hours.
An interval, at either grain, is stamped by the instant it **closes** —
an hourly `…T09:00:00Z` is the hour that ended at 09:00.

columns.description: Fields to return per market, from `list_fields`.

conditions.description:
Conditions, all of which must hold. A market that does not report a
field never satisfies a condition on it.

day.description:
The day or hour to screen: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `latest` at `bar: 1d`, a
completed `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:00:00Z` (the hour that *ended* there) or
`latest` at `bar: 1h`.

max_results.description:
How many markets to return, 1..100 (values outside are clamped to the
nearest bound and the response says so). Defaults to 25.

min_usd_volume_7d_avg.description:
Drop markets whose average **daily** traded notional over the trailing
window is below this value, in USD/day at either bar — a floor chosen at
`1d` means the same thing at `1h`.

order_by.description:
The field to rank the matches by. Defaults to the interval's traded
notional.

name: screen_universe

bar.description: The grain this answer was computed at: `1d` or `1h`.

eligible_count.description:
Markets left after your explicit market filter and any
traded-notional floor — the population the percentage conditions were
measured against.

visible_count.description:
Markets in your plan's slice with a row on this interval, before any
filter you passed.

title: Screen universe
